desc: 红发女孩在船上诞生的时候，肆虐海洋三天的风暴终于平息。家族将她视为诸神的礼物，并希望她在日后拥有主宰一切的自由。|这天，无数的贺礼从火山岛飞来：蛇饰金杯、日程闹钟、公平之箭和其他贵重之物；箱中的朋友们精心准备了手作蛋糕，巧克力牌上写着歪歪扭扭的奶油字：生日快乐。|鹭鸶剪宣称今天财运极佳——在东方，“八”可是发财的吉数，更何况是两个八呢？果不其然，在赫多涅的生日会上，每个人都得到了一颗亮闪闪的宝石。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪90年代，参展时长20年，诞生自8月8日夏。原展出地点为爱琴海区域某岛，现巡展于世界各地。

尺寸：82 43/64×33 15/32×19 11/16in.
介质：欢愉
香调：木质辛香调 番红花 肉桂木 琥珀 莱姆酒
灵感：不熄的熔岩[岩] 火山之主

character_data.title: “出于兴趣”
character_data.text:
长约两米的巨弓，通体镀金，辉煌如同太阳。它曾被供奉于远射神的神庙中，经历过漫长的岁月。
“老人们都说，没有人能拉开这张沉重的弓。我一时兴起，便尝试了一次——结果一箭射中了千米之外的圣火。”祭司于是将金弓赠予了诸神所爱之人。

character_data.title: 金王冠
character_data.text:
轻盈的黄金头冠，缀有银线串起的珍珠链。脱胎于千年前的王冠形制，并进行了简化设计。受访者称这是为了方便她参与到各种竞技运动中。
在火山岛，这顶头冠象征着王者的权力与威严，佩戴者应负起保护与传承的责任。但在这儿，它只是受访者发间雅致的点缀。

character_data.title: “命运之外”
character_data.text:
一套纯金构成的手臂护具，包含臂甲、臂环、腕甲与戒指。可被视为一桩交易的赠品，或是英雄命运的注解。
火山的力量可使其转变为任意形态。受访者离开火山岛后，它仍保有着此种“潜能”。
“离岛后，它的力量受到了限制，不能再像之前那样随心所欲地变换。不过，它依然乐意化作金箭——那是我最趁手的武器。”

character_data.title: 一枚银币的旅程
character_data.text:
广阔的帝国崩溃后，海洋上依旧遍布贸易家族的船帆。
希腊语是爱琴海的语言，德拉克马则是爱琴海的货币。一枚银币，在凯迈昂人的城邦中打造，经桨帆船运抵亚历山大港。在那里，它会被用于购买谷物、葡萄酒与橄榄油。第二个目的地是安条克城，那里的丝绸贸易十分繁荣。赚得盆满钵满的商人们携带着银币，继续向东进发，去往河畔的塞琉西亚城。人们喜欢交换那里的玻璃器、香料与象牙。最后，它或许会被某个富豪埋入地下；或是被丢入陶罐，与其他银币一起前往遥远的东方。
赫多涅把玩着手指间的银币，对它的命运烂熟于心。她自小便在船帆下生活，熟知财富的来处与流向。
海洋意味着黄金的机遇，也意味着危险与挑战。英雄与怪物的时代逐渐远去，但她喜欢追逐那些半人的怪物，还有以命相搏的乐趣。在海洋狩猎的途中，他们会路过一些燃着硝烟的城市，看到秃鹫在港口上盘旋。那时尚无人意识到：战争从未在历史中退场，强大的狼已经投来了目光。

character_data.title: 每口一乐
character_data.text:
白雪松：我之前采访过另外一位轮回者，与她不同……你完全变成了过去的你。
赫多涅：我一直都是我。火山岛的君主，击杀提丰的英雄——赫多涅。只是在觉醒之前，我缺少了作为“赫多涅”的记忆。
白雪松：在觉醒前，你是否考虑度过不同的人生？
赫多涅：我爱做的事情从未改变。竞技，挑战，追逐乐趣！我小时候就已经是许多赛事的冠军。
赫多涅：即使我从未觉醒轮回者的记忆，我仍会击败提丰，为火山岛带来一位新的君主，然后投入“奔流”之中。
白雪松：火山岛作为一处神秘学家的隐蔽之地，很少有信息流传到外界。
白雪松：既然你有意重启交流，我们想写一篇关于火山岛的独家报道。
赫多涅：交流仅限于少数贸易，我不会把火山岛完全暴露在外界的危险里。
赫多涅：你想做什么内容？
白雪松：我听闻你们保留了许多神圣传统，过着古典的古希腊神秘学家生活——
赫多涅：哈哈，我们不骑海豚上班，虽然我们可以！
赫多涅：嘴巴编辑，火山岛向来尊重文化的传承，但从不在时代的浪潮中落伍。
白雪松：听起来你有更好的想法？
赫多涅：我想插入一则广告。辛辣、清醇、物美价廉的火山岛神秘学饮料——每口一乐。
赫多涅：你们带动了商业宣传，我会给你们赞助费，这是双赢。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 金色的纺车？这可是传说中的宝藏！维尔汀，你比我想象的富有。#0|我很感兴趣，开个价吧，或是作为什么游戏的赌注……#6.8|哈哈，看来是非卖品！#10.7
character_voice.encontent: A golden Spinning Wheel? I've heard tales of such things. To hold one in your halls speaks well of your wealth, Vertin.#0|And now that it has caught my interest ... name your price—or perhaps you'd like to wager on it instead? #9|Hahaha, it seems I cannot tempt you! Too precious to be given a price, I take it?#17.6

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 晴朗的日子里，一排排海鸥掠过我们的船帆，#0|朋友们扯着嗓子，唱起粗糙的歌谣：#4.1|关于胜利，关于月下的葡萄藤，还有家乡那座燃着火炬的广场。#7.5
character_voice.encontent: On sunny days like these, memories of that radiant time find their way back to me.#0|Beneath the gulls swooping past the mast, my friends and I lifted our voices in song and laughter, #7|growing hoarse with tales of victory, of vine-covered fields, and of the torchlit square we left behind.#14.8

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 汹涌的“奔流”冲刷着世界……#0|我终有一日会亲手抓住它！在那之前，我不会停止追逐它的脚步。#2.1
character_voice.encontent: The "Downpour" draws the world into its current again and again ...#0|but I shall conquer it someday. And until that day, I will not falter.#5.1

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 不知道火山岛现在怎么样？#0|忒弥斯维持律法，阿波罗启迪智慧……#2.5|荷米斯会和大家一起，让整座岛充满活力。呵，我认可的挚友们……#6.3
character_voice.encontent: My mind oft wanders back to my friends in Ephaistonos.#0|Themis, steady as she is, must be keeping things in order; Apollo, acting as a guide to the people; #4.6|and Hermes is no doubt his usual energetic self. Heh ... what a mix of friends I have.#13.6

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 哦，维尔汀，你的步子很轻。我认识一些猎人，这是他们引以为傲的技巧。#0|不过，我更喜欢光明正大地站在敌人面前——#6.4|举起武器，直视彼此，看看谁会先在这场勇气之战中落败！#10.1
character_voice.encontent: You have the light footsteps of a huntress, akin to the best I've known.#0|But I must say, I prefer to meet my enemies face-to-face—#5|weapon drawn, eyes locked, and courage tested.#9.5

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 奶酪是火山岛上常见的早点。#0|出于兴趣，我曾在城邦间经营奶制品贸易，靠差价赚得了巨额利润……#2.4|维尔汀，你看起来很惊讶？哈哈！在战斗的技艺之外，我还掌握着创造财富的秘诀。#8.1
character_voice.encontent: Cheese is a common sight at any Ephaistonos breakfast table.#0|I even once took part in its making and trade myself. It only began as a whim, but it proved unexpectedly profitable ... #4.2|You look surprised. Surely you did not think me only versed in combat?#13.5

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 离乡前的清晨，东风鼓满了船帆。#0|有人请求我留下，他们听到了一则预言：关于危险的未来与孤独的命运……#3.3|哈哈，尽管来吧！我不会害怕，也不会后悔。#10.2
character_voice.encontent: I recall how the eastern wind swelled the sails of our ship and the courage in our chests on that last morning in Greece all those years ago.#0|I was told to stay, for the auguries warned of great danger, and with it, equal loneliness. #9.8|Hah ... And yet, I did not flinch. I was not afraid then, and I will carry no regret now.#17.7

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 看看南面的天空，在最亮最宽的银河中，你会找到人马座……#0|我对观星不感兴趣，但看到射手驰骋天际，总是令人身心愉悦。#5.6
character_voice.encontent: Near the southern horizon, along the brightest band of the Milky Way, you will find Sagittarius ...#0|I've never cared much for the stars, but I do enjoy the sight of the Archer drawing his bow across the night sky.#8.1

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 那是个遥远的宴会夜晚，#0|我年过九十，仍能一箭射中百步外的靶标。#2.2|又一次的胜利后，我饮尽双耳杯的葡萄酒，沉沉睡去。之后嘛……#6.2|凡人终有一死，我也不能例外。#13.3
character_voice.encontent: It was a night of feasting and revelry.#0|I was well over 90 years of age, yet my hands remained steady enough to strike the mark with a single draw. #3.4|And as the crowd roared, I drained my cup to their chorus before slipping into a long, silent sleep. #11.9|Such is the fate of mortals, and I was no exception.#21.1

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我的头冠以纯金打造。昂贵，纯净，璀璨如同太阳。所有人都喜欢黄金。#0|但别像那些炼金术士一样死板，它是取悦的手段，而非生活的目的。#6.5
character_voice.encontent: A crown forged from pure gold so it would blaze like the sun itself. A mineral as desirable as it is ruinous ...#0|Remember, gold is a means to pursuing purpose and pleasure, not the purpose and pleasure itself.#10.3

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 我的家族从事海上贸易，所得的财富数不胜数。#0|这些宝石不过是我的一小部分收藏。#4.6|我不介意将它们尽数赠予给我的挚友、子民，甚至是敌人——只要他们能取悦我。#7.7|但你可以随意挑选，维尔汀。因为你早已得到了我的认可。#15.2
character_voice.encontent: My family gathered immeasurable wealth through maritime trade.#0|These jewels? Mere trifles from my treasury. #4.9|I share them freely with my companions, my people, even my enemies, provided they prove themselves worthy of pleasing me. #9.3|Go on, Vertin, choose one for yourself. You have earned my acknowledgment.#19.1

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 在百种战斗的技艺中，弓箭是我最爱的一种。#0|它精准、优雅，破空而过，为敌人带来命中注定的死亡。#4.1
character_voice.encontent: Of the hundreds of ways to wage battle, archery remains my favorite.#0|It is precise, graceful, swift ... a most dignified way to deliver death.#6.2

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 在百种战斗的技艺中，弓箭是我最爱的一种。#0|它精准、优雅，破空而过，为敌人带来命中注定的死亡。#4.1
character_voice.encontent: Of the hundreds of ways to wage battle, archery remains my favorite.#0|It is precise, graceful, swift ... a most dignified way to deliver death.#6.2

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 运动会是很好的热身机会，它让我探知到身体的极限——#0|甚至，偶尔可以引领我突破极限。#4.1|在那之后，我可以满怀激情冲入征战。#7.5
character_voice.encontent: The Aquatic Games are a fitting prelude to a true battle—they awaken every fiber of my being, driving me to my limits,#0|and at times even pushing me beyond them. #9.4|There is simply no better way to prime mind and flesh for a fight.#12.8

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 我的挚友！你的判断力令我印象深刻。#0|战场上的形势瞬息万变，当机立断是一位领导者最好的品质。#3.4
character_voice.encontent: My friend, your judgment has impressed me.#0|Know that a swift mind is the greatest virtue a leader may have, especially when the tides of battle are wont to shift quickly.#3.7

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，你该提高空间搭配的品味。#0|箱中需要翻修了，四角应布置洁白的罗马柱，墙上该有彩绘的壁画。#2.9|别忘了酒吧里的金杯、骰子玩具，还有运动竞技俱乐部……#8.3|你看上去很为难？别担心，我会提供资金！#13.5
character_voice.encontent: Your Suitcase is in need of a complete renovation, Vertin!#0|Let there be classical orders to hold up the ceiling, and frescoes to lighten these walls,#4| golden cups in the bar, and dice for drinking games! And, of course, you need a proper sports club ... #9.5|Why the hesitation? You needn't worry. I'll provide all the funds required.#18.5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 这是个小小的运气游戏：抛起硬币，猜测是正面向上还是反面向上，运气坏的人罚酒一杯。#0|百夫长已经使我举杯三次……#7.3|呵，偶尔输几次，我不讨厌。#9.5
character_voice.encontent: It's a simple game of chance: toss the coin and guess the side it lands on. If you fail, you drink.#0|Centurion has already had me raise my cup three times ... #7.7|Hah, there's no harm in the occasional defeat.#12

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 你是否听说过那些古典戏剧？#0|刺瞎双眼的国王、被钉在悬崖上的盗火者……#2.4|我厌烦了这些宿命论的故事，厌烦了那些“神”。#6.6
character_voice.encontent: Are you familiar with those classical tales?#0|The king whose eyes were gouged out, the fire thief who was nailed to the cliff ... #3.4|I've heard enough stories in which heroes meet their destined downfall.#9.6

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 史诗讲述英雄的千般面孔：智慧的、暴怒的、勇武的。#0|但在史诗之外，还有孤独。我的朋友们曾祭祀诸神，请求他们的庇护……#5.8|但最终，我独自还乡，身旁空无一人。#15
character_voice.encontent: The heroes of the epic tales each possess their own qualities—some are wise, others fiery, or brave.#0|But there is one thing they all share: loneliness ... #9.7|A thing I only came to understand most fully when I returned to my ship with no one by my side.#15.1

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 速战速决！#0
character_voice.encontent: Let us bring this to a swift end!#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 厮杀吧！#0
character_voice.encontent: The hunt begins!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: *响指的声音*#0
character_voice.encontent: *snaps fingers*#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 来玩玩吧。#0
character_voice.encontent: Come! Let us make sport of this!#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 赞颂勇武。#0
character_voice.encontent: Let valor be praised.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 直面命运。#0
character_voice.encontent: Do not flinch from the touch of the fates.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 一点小火焰。#0
character_voice.encontent: Only a spark.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 呵呵，别害怕。#0
character_voice.encontent: Now, now, don't fret.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 箭无虚发！#0
character_voice.encontent: You'll not escape my arrow's mark!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 还想逃？#0
character_voice.encontent: Think you can elude me?#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 欢愉之时！#0
character_voice.encontent: Unleash the revelrous tide!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 仅此而已？#0
character_voice.encontent: Is that all you have?#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 有趣！#0
character_voice.encontent: Interesting!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 永远追随变化，永远与变化交锋。#0|我为你调了无酒精鸡尾酒，来吧，庆祝我们的胜利！#3.3
character_voice.encontent: No tide shall stand against us!#0|Raise your cups and drink—to victory!#2.4

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我曾痛恨朋友们的弱小，痛恨我未能守护所有人……#0|但我忘记了，正是他们的信任和帮助，让我得以斩杀提丰。#6.3|维尔汀，你证明了自己的强大，我也会将全部的信任托付于你。#12.6
character_voice.encontent: For a long time, I was haunted by the loss of my friends ... I even came to resent them for leaving me.#0|But I forgot that it was their faith in me which gave me the strength to overcome Typhon. #10.3|And now, I would grant that same faith to you, Vertin. For you have proven yourself worthy of it.#17.1

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，我感到非凡的力量在四肢中奔涌，就像千年前一样。#0|那是属于激情与变化的时代，“双翼的怪物在云中尖啸，神明与英雄同驰于大地”……#6.5|那黄金般的时代已成历史。#14.4
character_voice.encontent: I feel power coursing through my veins, as it did when the volcano first granted me its power.#0|It was a time of glory, when winged monsters shrieked in the skies, and gods and heroes fought as one. #7.4|A truly golden age.#15.6

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，我感到非凡的力量在四肢中奔涌，就像千年前一样。#0|那是属于激情与变化的时代，“双翼的怪物在云中尖啸，神明与英雄同驰于大地”……#6.5|那黄金般的时代已成历史。#14.4
character_voice.encontent: I feel power coursing through my veins, as it did when the volcano first granted me its power.#0|It was a time of glory, when winged monsters shrieked in the skies, and gods and heroes fought as one. #7.4|A truly golden age.#15.6

character_voice.name: 特殊交互1
character_voice.content: 我的家族从事海上贸易，所得的财富数不胜数。#0|这些宝石不过是我的一小部分收藏。#4.6|我不介意将它们尽数赠予给我的挚友、子民，甚至是敌人——只要他们能取悦我。#7.7|但你可以随意挑选，维尔汀。因为你早已得到了我的认可。#15.2
character_voice.encontent: My family gathered immeasurable wealth through maritime trade.#0|These jewels? Mere trifles from my treasury. #4.9|I share them freely with my companions, my people, even my enemies, provided they prove themselves worthy of pleasing me. #9.3|Go on, Vertin, choose one for yourself. You have earned my acknowledgment.#19.1

character_voice.name: 特殊交互2
character_voice.encontent: Take it.#0

skin.name: 赫多涅
skin.skinDescription: 她是一切欢愉与财富的主人。

skin.name: 赫多涅
skin.skinDescription: 岩浆冷却之后，一场漫长的告别。

1391041.content: 我原以为要花些时间适应新的变化，但当我穿过林荫，来到一片浅滩，站在那儿眺望——
这里的水域和爱琴海同样一望无际、涌动着活力——正适合举办一届水上运动会！
哈哈哈哈，那容易被惊吓的圣火！
但你说得不错，关于竞技比赛，那圣火一向有很多好点子。
届时赛场上，我期待再次与你并肩驰骋，维尔汀。
譬如扑克牌或斯诺克？不错的提议。
火山岛的运动项目也几经演变。从前大家纯粹追逐着力量与野性，如今不少注重策略技巧的项目也被融入其中。
就让这些桌上小游戏也加入水上运动会的项目清单吧。譬如……在浅水区举办多人充气斯诺克！

1391042.content: 我恰巧洗好了牌，要来一局吗？
我很欣赏，你一向如此果决！
要是你赢下这局，我将不吝与你分享我全部的宝藏。
但若我赢了——维尔汀，箱中的布置翻新该快些提上日程，就从四角新立罗马柱开始！
二十一点，或者德州扑克？你来选择即可。
你在犹豫——担心你选择的游戏我没接触过，有失公平？
哈哈哈哈……找到我不擅长的游戏，这恐怕比从我手中赢一局要难些！
不过，这也是我愿与你成为挚友的原因之一——你总是如此，光明磊落、持论公允。

1391041.content: 或许和平乌鲁也同样有兴趣
先从趣味游戏开始怎么样？
